title: Gaudí Column (Shader)
description: A fragment-shader Gaudí column. Two fluted star profiles are swept up the shaft and twisted opposite ways; their radial minimum carves the grooves, which spiral because the twist grows with height. It renders as a lit stone column, and two misgeneration modes then treat its surface — Moiré interference beats a high-frequency grid against itself into shimmering pink fringes, and Edge warping pinches and tears the flutes near the silhouette with hard high-contrast overfitted rings, like a neural net hallucinating detail. Column width, both profiles' point count and twist, groove depth, mode and speed are live; the beat opens the grooves. (For the same pattern across the whole plane, see Gaudí Fold Field.)
